question: PQ and RS are two parallel chords of a circle of length 10 cm and 24 cm, respectively, and lie on the same side of the centre O. If the distance between the chords is 7 cm, what is the radius (in cm) of the circle?
solution:
**Given:** 

Two chords of length of 10 cm and 24 cm on the same side of center

distance between chords is 7 cm

**To find:** 

Radius of circle

**Concept used:**

Pythagorean theorem

Calculation**:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70512a4b7e141371dea6b286b624456bb0bf61bfced785a451cf72749f30933.png] 

Let A be the point on RS and B be the point on PQ,

⇒ RA =1/2(RS) = 1/2(24) = 12

⇒ PB = 1/2(PQ) = 1/2(10) = 5 

In Δ OAR, ∠ OAR = 90° 

Using the Pythagoras theorem, 

⇒ OR² = OA² + AR²

⇒ r² = OA² + 12²

⇒ r² = OA² + 144 (1)

In Δ OBP, ∠ OBP = 90° 

Using the Pythagoras theorem, 

⇒ OP² = PB² + OB²

⇒ r² = 5² + (OA + 7)²

⇒ r² = 25 + OA² + 49 + 14OA 

⇒ r² = OA² + 14OA + 74 (2)

Equating equations 1 & 2, we get, 

⇒ OA² + 144 = ​OA² + 14OA + 74 

⇒ 70 = 14OA

⇒ OA = 70/14 = 5 

Now, in Δ OAR, 

⇒ OR² = OA² + AR² 

⇒ {r}²={5}²+144

⇒ r² = √169 

⇒Radius = 13 cm

**The radius of the circle is 13 cm**
